description: This is the main FastAPI application source file for the subtitle synchronization backend. It sets up API routes for health checks, file uploads, processing status queries, subtitle retrieval, and documentation, handling background processing of media files with WhisperX, as well as database initialization and middleware configuration.

classes.description: Response model for file upload endpoint, indicating upload status and details.

classes.description: Response model for processing status queries.

methods.description: Handles uploading media files, storing them, creating DB records, and triggering background processing.

methods.description: Retrieves current processing status for a specific media file.
